newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemeni murderers executed then crucified.
newsitem.headline: Yemeni murderers executed then crucified.

text.p: Yemen on Friday executed two convicted murderers by firing squad then crucified their bodies on a street in the east-central town of Sayun, security sources said.
The sources said the men were part of a seven-member gang which had killed three people and wounded two after it flagged down their car to rob them in Hadramaut province on June 19.
Police later clashed with the gang, killing five members and arresting the other two.
The men were sentenced to death on July 13.
